text:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-331 resolved at 2026-03-10T14:12:00Z. Root cause still under investigation. Creating follow-up thread for customer comms and postmortem scheduling.

oncall-jamie: I kicked off the mitigation earlier, services are stable now. starting a quick checklist for follow-ups. pinging @sre-ana and @pm-maya for RCA timeline.

sre-ana: Thanks. I have a preliminary timeline and will own the immediate RCA draft. ETA for initial RCA (internal) is EOD today UTC+0. More detailed postmortem by Wed COB.

eng-sam: I can provide the kernel/serving logs and the patch diff for the retry logic that tripped. Will attach in the PM.

pm-maya: Customer-facing comms plan: quick status page recap + optional detailed RCA share if customer requests. We should confirm whether to proactively send the RCA to affected customers or wait for their request. Recommendation: proactive for key accounts.

cs-ryan: We hit three customers with higher token failures: Acme, NovaPay, and ClearHealth. Acme is on a Dedicated account, high priority. I started a threaded DM with Acme to acknowledge and promised a consolidated note by EOD.

oncall-jamie: Handoff note before I go offline in 30m: oncall-lee will take the oncall pager. @oncall-lee please confirm you’ve accepted and seen the mitigation steps in the incident channel.

oncall-lee: I’m on it, saw the runbook and logs. Accepted the handoff. I’ll monitor for 2 more hours and escalate if recurrence. :thumbsup:

sre-ana: Action items I’m logging now: 1) Collect KV cache metrics and router traces (owner: ana, due: EOD) 2) Export runtime retry logs + last 12h traces (owner: sam, due: EOD) 3) Draft internal RCA (owner: ana, due: EOD) 4) Postmortem meeting + invite (owner: maya, due: tomorrow morning) 5) Customer comms draft for Acme & NovaPay (owner: ryan, owner support: maya, due: EOD)

eng-sam: I created a gist with the key logs: https://redwood.internal/gist/incident-1763001234 (internal only). Also reproducer in the repo at infra/retries/issue-331.patch

pm-maya: Proposed status page public blurb (please review):

```
Current status: Services operational. Between 13:35 and 13:55 UTC on 2026-03-10, a subset of request traffic experienced elevated retry failures causing higher latency and occasional request failures for a small percentage of customers. We implemented a mitigation at 14:05 UTC which restored normal service. We are investigating the root cause and will post a follow-up with details.
```

cs-ryan: That reads well. For Acme, I recommend a slightly more detailed private summary that includes customer impact window and confirmation of workaround. Draft below:

```
Hi <Account Owner>,

We wanted to let you know about an incident that occurred on 2026-03-10 between 13:35-14:05 UTC that impacted a subset of requests to the Redwood API. During this window, your requests experienced increased retries and elevated latency. We applied a mitigation which restored normal operation at ~14:05 UTC. We are preparing a detailed RCA and will share an internal version by EOD today and a full postmortem by Wed.

Next steps:
- Root cause analysis in progress (internal)
- Postmortem and concrete fixes with timelines to follow

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll keep you updated and are happy to hop on a call if you’d like.

Regards,
Redwood Support
```

oncall-jamie: +1 proactive outreach to Acme. For the status page, add the number of affected customers (estimate) if we can confirm: ~3 customers, <0.05% of traffic. If we’re not comfortable with the exact figure, say "a small percentage".

sre-ana: Confirmed traffic impact: approx 0.03% of total requests, spike concentrated on Dedicated routers in eu-west1. I'll add that to the internal RCA.

pm-maya: Scheduling: I propose postmortem meeting Thu 09:00 UTC (30m). Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood/postmortem/1763001234. Please RSVP.

eng-sam: I can join Thu 09:00 and will prepare the trace + diff.

cs-ryan: I'll prep the customer list and tailored messages. Can we include a short FAQ section for customers who ask about SLAs/credits?

pm-maya: Yes — include this placeholder FAQ in the customer note:

```
Q: Will we receive credits for the downtime?
A: We evaluate SLA credits case-by-case. Please open a support ticket referencing INC-2026-331 and we’ll review.
```

oncall-lee: Quick ops follow-up: I updated the runbook with one extra mitigator (temporary router pinning) and a note to check KV cache warmup after deploys. PR: infra/playbooks/incident-runbook.md#L220

sre-ana: Thanks. I'll include recommended permanent remediation (backoff tuning + a guard to drop bad retry headers) in the postmortem. Owner: ana + eng-sam, due: 2 weeks.

oncall-jamie: Before I sign off: can someone own the customer RCA share to Acme? Ryan? Maya?

cs-ryan: I’ll own outreach for Acme and NovaPay. Will send drafts in the next hour for review.

pm-maya: I'll own scheduling & external status page update once internal RCA is approved. Plan: publish status page update w/in 24h of internal RCA approval.

eng-sam: FYI - I noticed a subtle race in the retry logic that only triggers on dedicated router sticky sessions. Patch is low-risk, will open PR after the postmortem for testing and can fast-track for Dedicated accounts.

incident-bot: Reminder: Fill the incident form (link: https://incidents.redwood/forms/1763001234) and mark severity and customer impact.

oncall-jamie: Copy. I’ve filled initial fields. Thanks everyone — I’m handing off to @oncall-lee and will check back tomorrow. :wave:

oncall-lee: Got it. Monitoring alert rules lowered threshold for the next 24h. Will escalate if we see recurrence.

pm-maya: Recap of next concrete deliverables (short):
- Internal RCA draft (ana) — EOD today
- Postmortem + meeting invite (maya) — Thu 09:00 UTC
- Customer drafts for Acme & NovaPay (ryan) — EOD today
- Patch PR + test plan (sam) — PR opened before Fri
- Update runbook (lee) — PR merged by Tue

cs-ryan: Drafts coming shortly. ping me in this thread for quick approvals.

sre-ana: Internal RCA uploaded to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1763001234/rca (internal only). Marking the incident for postmortem review.

pm-maya: Approved the calendar invite. Added PM/CS/Eng/SRE.

oncall-lee: Accepted. I’ll drop a short watch note in the oncall rota channel if anything changes.

eng-sam: Quick note for the postmortem — include token-level cost impact estimate if possible. I’ll calculate from logs and add to the document.

cs-ryan: Sent initial private note to Acme, waiting ack. Will share the sent copy once I get one.

pm-maya: Great. Thanks all. Closing this follow-up thread — reopening if anything changes. :lock:
